title: Cashew Mousse with Zesty Canadian Twist
description: A creamy cashew mousse with a zesty Canadian flavor, perfect for a sweet and tangy dessert.
instructions: 1. Drain and rinse the soaked cashews.
2. Add the cashews, zesty mixture, Canadian flavor, maple syrup, coconut cream, and vanilla extract to a blender.
3. Blend the mixture on high speed until smooth and creamy.
4. Taste and adjust the sweetness or zesty level as needed.
5. Transfer the mousse to individual serving cups or a large serving dish.
6. Chill the mousse in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours.
7. Serve the mousse chilled, garnished with fresh fruit or whipped cream if desired.
